facts.claim: Eurodam (Holland America Line): Entered service 2008; 86,700 GT; 2120 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 285 m length; Signature class.
MS Eurodam is a Signature-class cruise ship for Holland America Line.

Eurodam is the 80th ship to enter Holland America's service, and at 86,700 tons and carrying 2,104 passengers, the 2nd largest of two HAL Signature-class ships, along with her slightly larger & newer sister ship MS Nieuw Amsterdam.
